title: lint: the save door stores a live flow with no start node; a runtime authoring-gate rule should refuse it at save and publish and keep a draft with a diagnostic
body:
domain:server#7 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

carries the metadata-save-door half of #32142 ("the save door refuses the shape that can never run"); #32142 keeps its advisory half (unknown positions, queues and channels warn at save). PR #32273 refuses the shape at engine registration only.

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named site, found by the #32142 card thread (os-dev report 6772313568, open question 2) and confirmed by the contract review of PR #32273 (record 6772843445, ③). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: MCP and AI builders write flows through `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME`. A live flow with no start node still stores there and the author learns it is refused only from a later read (`registration: refused`), which is the silent acceptance AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12 forbids.
Reader: triage first touch. `packages/lint` is spec-lane by the anchoring rule.

## What to do (the #32142 dev's measured recommendation, not a ruling)

- A rule on the runtime authoring gate in `packages/lint` (beside `flow-node-unreachable` in `lint-flow-patterns.ts`) that refuses a live save and a publish of a flow whose top-level `nodes` hold no `start` node, and keeps a draft with a diagnostic. Not a `FlowSchema` refinement, which would refuse a designer draft mid-edit, the reason `lint-flow-patterns.ts` gives for keeping `flow-node-unreachable` out of the parse.
- Correct `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`. It says a flow with no start node "is not judged: the flow parse refuses those shapes first", and the parse does not, before or after #32273. re-check: `git grep -n "the flow parse refuses those shapes first" origin/main -- packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (control: `flow-node-unreachable` in the same file).
- Optional, the spec lane's call: an ADR-0087 semantic upgrade-guide entry for the narrowing, with `picklist-binding-unknown-refused` as the precedent of the same shape (contract review ③).

Dedupe (open and closed), run 2026-11-10 16:27 UTC: `flow-node-unreachable start node lint save` (4 hits: #32142 the parent; #31224, #31155 and #20590 are closed and not on point).
